play: Organ-protection explainer from a credentialed expert
evidence: Clarity's engine. Kidney videos: 1,089, 20% ran 30+ days (index 1.67); brain: index 1.91. Authority hooks index 1.84; doctor-style explainers 704 videos, index 1.51.
how: Real, verifiable expert names the viewer's worry, explains the hidden oxidative cause, says why their current fix fails, then the product. Never invent a doctor or use a real person's name.

play: "What happens when you take it every day" antioxidant short
evidence: Rovina's best angle: oxidative stress 164 videos, 70% ran 30+ days (index 1.47). Day-by-day timelines: 261 videos, 47% winners, the longest at 129 days. 30–60s runs index 1.27.
how: Open on the daily-use curiosity line, walk through what the viewer would notice week by week (energy, skin, recovery), name the product inside 10–30s.

evidence: Rovina quality videos: 247, 60% winners (index 1.27). Quality-exposé flow across both brands: 468 videos, index 1.15, significantly above.
how: List the rules a real product must meet (source, dose, oil-based softgel) and show Haskap meets each. Strong for product-aware buyers comparing brands.

evidence: Rovina skits: 61 videos, 66% winners (index 1.39); skit openers index 1.36. 'What do you mean the sale ends today?' was re-shot 29 times across both brands, 20 ran 30+ days.
how: Cheap to produce, highly re-shootable. Use for the sale/urgency layer and for an animated 'cells vs free radicals' explainer.

play: Customer testimonial arc (before → found it → after)
evidence: Clarity testimonials: 100 videos, index 1.72; testimonial-arc flow index 1.57 (both significant).
how: Real customers only. A specific symptom they noticed, what they tried, what changed. Keep outcomes to how they feel, not diagnoses.

evidence: Scripts with a bundle: index 1.10; with a price anchor ('under $17 a bag'): index 1.22. Free-shipping mentions underperform (Clarity index 0.41).
how: Close on a bundle and a per-unit price anchor; don't lead with free shipping or gifts.

evidence: Small but strong at Clarity: 47 videos, 32% winners (index 2.61). Weaker at Rovina.
how: Low-budget test with real GLP-1 users talking about energy and skin while losing weight.

evidence: Joint-led videos: 52 across both brands, 12% ran 30+ days (index 0.50, significantly below). Clarity: 0 of 36. Joint-sufferer avatar index 0.38.
how: Keep joints as one line inside antioxidant or timeline scripts (Rovina's timelines mention knees). Only test a joint-led concept small.
